theses.subject: Banks

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme and the nominal challenger, but its hurst tag is 'mean-revert' and breadth is only 0.2 — the rally is extremely narrow (likely one or two names), the opposite of a durable trend. Rotation margin to Banks is 0.071, a slight gap, with no confirmed handoff (directional=false, absorption 0.35). In a mean-reverting tape where the trend gate fails, chasing a narrow mean-revert leg is exactly the shake-out risk the gate is designed to avoid — but the gate doesn't help here, so I'd steer clear.
evidence: crowding_z=0.5, crowded=false (no positioning signal either way)
theses.dissent: Coal is the only other eligible theme in a market starved of eligible trends; if Banks roll over, Coal's mean-revert tag could actually catch a short squeeze into a risk-off rotation.
